core_meaning.primary_meaning: Ghizlan is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Gazelle”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Ghizlan corresponds to the Arabic form غزلان (Arabic root غ ز ل (gh-z-l); plural غزلان (ghizlān)). Its core sense is gazelles (plural). Ghizlan (غزلان) is the plural of غزال (ghazāl) 'gazelle' — 'gazelles'. The source gloss 'steadfast, determined' is unsupported and has been replaced with the actual lexical sense.
